reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `icite_unreachable`: NIH iCite failed on every attempt the retry budget allowed — a network failure or an HTTP 5xx. `icite_invalid_response`: NIH iCite returned a body that is not its JSON record list on the last attempt the retry budget allowed. `icite_unrequested_record`: NIH iCite answered with a record for a PMID the call did not request, or one whose PMID is not a PMID — the answer it gives this PMID list every time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

definition.name: pubmed__pubmed_europepmc_search_3a375f93
definition.title: Pubmed Europepmc Search
definition.description: Search Europe PMC, a broad open-access biomedical corpus. Surfaces preprints (`source: PPR`), patents (`source: PAT`), Agricola (`source: AGR`), plus everything in PubMed (`MED`) and PMC. Use when additional coverage is needed — preprints and EPMC-only OA records are the typical recovery. Paginate via `cursorMark`. Defaults to `MED`, `PMC`, and `PPR`; pass `sources` to include `PAT` / `AGR`. Abstracts arrive as a bounded `abstractSnippet` with `abstractTruncated` marking the cut ones — pass a hit to `pubmed_europepmc_fetch` as `records: [{ source, epmcId }]` for the complete abstract.

query.description: Europe PMC search query. Supports field tokens like `AUTH:""`, `JOURNAL:""`, `TITLE:"<words>"`, `PUB_YEAR:[2020 TO 2024]`, `DOI:"..."`, `EXT_ID:<pmid> AND SRC:MED`, `PMCID:PMC<digits>`. Identifier tokens may be quoted or unquoted — this tool wraps every query with its `sources` filter, and Europe PMC honors a quoted identifier inside that wrapper. A PubMed-indexed article resolves under `SRC:MED`, not `SRC:PMC`, whichever identifier is used. Free text is matched broadly across abstract/title/keywords. A query with no search term — blank once HTML entities are decoded and markup, parentheses, and invisible characters are disregarded, such as `()` or `<b></b>` — is rejected; any other query is sent as written.

pageSize.description: Results per page, up to 100 per call (this server's cap; Europe PMC itself serves up to 1,000). A larger value is served at 100, with a notice; continue from `nextCursorMark`.

cursorMark.description: Pagination cursor. Use `*` (default) for the first page; pass the previous response's `nextCursorMark` verbatim for subsequent pages. Under relevance ranking (no `sort`), a record can reappear on the next page, so de-duplicate hits by `epmcId` across pages. A whitespace-only cursor, invisible characters included, is rejected before the request, and a cursor Europe PMC cannot read fails with `europepmc_invalid_input` once a retry of it fails again while the first page of the same query is served.

sources.description: Filter to specific EPMC sources. Defaults to MED, PMC, PPR when omitted. Pass an explicit array including PAT or AGR to broaden coverage. Allowed values: MED, PMC, PPR, PAT, AGR.

resultType.description: `core` returns abstract, IDs, dates, license; `lite` is a smaller payload with the same IDs, title, authors, journal, and dates, but no abstract or license.

sort.description: Optional EPMC sort: `<field> asc|desc`, or several comma-separated keys applied in order (`PUB_YEAR desc, CITED desc`). Documented sortable fields: `P_PDATE_D` (publication date), `CITED` (citation count), `AUTH_FIRST` (first author surname), `PUB_YEAR` (publication year), `FIRST_IDATE_D` (date first indexed in Europe PMC). Examples: `P_PDATE_D desc` (newest first), `CITED desc` (most cited). Omit for relevance ranking; `relevance` or `relevance desc` is sent as no sort. Field and direction match case-insensitively. Each key must be one field plus `asc` or `desc`: a key without a direction, an empty key, or an extra word fails with `europepmc_invalid_input` before the request. A field outside the documented set may be honored, silently ignored, or refused — a sort Europe PMC refuses fails with `europepmc_invalid_input` naming it, and an empty Europe PMC response to a sort with an undocumented field fails the same way, even when Europe PMC honors the field. Note: `P_PDATE_D` is ignored for preprint-only (`sources: ["PPR"]`) result sets — preprints have no populated publication date, so use `PUB_YEAR desc` to order preprints by date.

source.description: Europe PMC source — `MED` (PubMed), `PMC` (PubMed Central), `PPR` (preprint), `PAT` (patent), `AGR` (Agricola)

epmcId.description: Europe PMC's internal record id. Pass it with this hit's `source` to `pubmed_europepmc_fetch` as `records: [{ source, epmcId }]` for the complete record. `pubmed_fetch_fulltext` takes this hit's `pmcId`, `pmid`, or `doi`, not this id.

title.description: Article title as display-ready plain text — JATS/HTML markup stripped and HTML entities decoded.

authors.description: Formatted author string as display-ready plain text — JATS/HTML markup stripped and HTML entities decoded.

journal.description: Journal name as Europe PMC reports it — its MEDLINE abbreviation where it records one (e.g. `Otolaryngol Pol`), else the full journal title — the same for `resultType` `core` and `lite`. Display-ready plain text — JATS/HTML markup stripped and HTML entities decoded. Absent when Europe PMC carries no journal, as for preprints.

pmcId.description: PMC ID when present in PMC

doi.description: DOI when present, cased as Europe PMC reports it. DOIs are case-insensitive by spec and no case normalization is applied here, so the same DOI can arrive in a different case from `pubmed_fetch_articles` (Europe PMC `10.1056/nejmoa2212948`, NCBI `10.1056/NEJMoa2212948`) — a byte-for-byte comparison across the two reports a false mismatch.

isOpenAccess.description: Whether EPMC reports the record as open access

hasFullTextXml.description: Whether Europe PMC publishes a fullTextXML for this record: true when Europe PMC marks it open access and lists a full-text id for it, open-access preprints (`PPR`) included; false otherwise. Absent when Europe PMC reports no open-access status.

license.description: License Europe PMC records for this record, verbatim (e.g. `cc by`, `cc by-nc-nd`, `cc0`). Relayed as Europe PMC states it, never interpreted. Absent when Europe PMC supplies none, and on every `resultType: "lite"` result.

abstractSnippet.description: First 400 characters of the abstract as display-ready plain text — JATS/HTML markup stripped and HTML entities decoded — when `resultType: "core"` is requested, with a trailing … appended when the abstract was cut. Check `abstractTruncated` before treating it as the whole abstract.

abstractTruncated.description: Whether `abstractSnippet` was cut short of the full abstract. Retrieve the complete text by passing this record to `pubmed_europepmc_fetch` as `records: [{ source, epmcId }]`. Present whenever `abstractSnippet` is; omitted when Europe PMC carries no abstract.

citedByCount.description: Citation count reported by Europe PMC

items.description: Single Europe PMC record returned by the search

hits.description: Matching Europe PMC records, in the order EPMC returned them

cursorMark.description: Cursor used for this response (echoed from the request)

nextCursorMark.description: Cursor to pass back as `cursorMark` for the next page. Absent on a page shorter than `pageSize`, which ends the result set. A full page that happens to end it still carries one, and the page it leads to comes back empty.

searchUrl.description: Europe PMC's website search URL for this query

totalCount.description: Total matching records across all pages

query.description: Effective query string echoed by Europe PMC

appliedSources.description: Sources the query was filtered against (defaults applied)

notice.description: Optional guidance when results are empty, when a cursor is past the last result, when Europe PMC ignores a date sort on preprint-only results, or when a `pageSize` past the per-call cap of 100 was served at 100.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `europepmc_unreachable`: Europe PMC failed on every retry attempt — unreachable, an HTTP 404 or 5xx other than a 504 timeout from its search endpoint, or an empty response with no results. `europepmc_invalid_response`: Europe PMC returned a body that could not be parsed (invalid JSON or XML). `europepmc_invalid_input`: Europe PMC rejected the request input — an error message in place of results; a sort it cannot use (one whose keys are not each a field plus asc/desc, rejected before any request; an empty response to a sort with an undocumented field; or a second HTTP 503 to a sorted search when the same query without the sort is served); or a pagination cursor it cannot read (an empty response on the last attempt the retry budget allows, or a second HTTP 503 when the first page of the same query is served). `blank_query`: The query contains no search term: nothing is left once whitespace and invisible characters such as a zero-width space are disregarded. pubmed_search_articles and pubmed_europepmc_search first decode HTML entities and also disregard markup and parentheses, so `()`, ``, and ` ` hold no term there; pubmed_search_articles also disregards bracketed field tags such as `[pdat]`. On pubmed_search_articles an exactly-empty `query` is not blank: it means no query, and the search runs on its filters. `blank_cursor`: The `cursorMark` holds only whitespace or invisible characters such as a zero-width space. Europe PMC cannot read it and answers with the HTTP 503 it also uses for an outage. `europepmc_disabled`: Europe PMC service is disabled via EUROPEPMC_ENABLED=false. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

definition.name: pubmed__pubmed_europepmc_fetch_98b19915
definition.title: Pubmed Europepmc Fetch
definition.description: Fetch complete Europe PMC records — including the full, untruncated abstract — addressed as `records: [{ source, epmcId }]`, an array even for one record. Pairs with `pubmed_europepmc_search`, which returns bounded `abstractSnippet` values and flags cut ones with `abstractTruncated: true`; copy each hit's `source` and `epmcId` into `records` here to read the whole abstract. This is the retrieval path for preprint (`PPR`), patent (`PAT`), and Agricola (`AGR`) records, which frequently carry no PMID and no DOI, so `pubmed_fetch_articles` and `pubmed_fetch_fulltext` cannot address them. Up to 25 records per call. Set `maxResponseCharacters` to bound the whole response: records past the ceiling are deferred whole and listed in `deferred.records` for a follow-up call.

source.description: Europe PMC source corpus — `MED` (PubMed), `PMC` (PubMed Central), `PPR` (preprint), `PAT` (patent), `AGR` (Agricola). Copy it from the search hit's `source`. `PMC` paired with a PMCID resolves whether or not the article is also indexed in PubMed, and a PubMed-indexed one comes back as its canonical `MED` record carrying that PMCID in `pmcId`.

epmcId.description: Europe PMC's own record id within that source. Copy it from the search hit's `epmcId` — for `MED` records this is the PMID; for the other sources it is an EPMC-native accession.

items.description: One record address: the Europe PMC source corpus plus its id within that corpus

records.description: Records to retrieve, each addressed by the `source` and `epmcId` of a `pubmed_europepmc_search` hit. The whole batch resolves in one Europe PMC request.

maxResponseCharacters.description: Opt-in ceiling for the whole response, in characters. Each record is measured as the JSON record it is returned as — title, authors, journal, abstract, identifiers, every field it carries. Records are kept in the order Europe PMC returned them until the next one would cross the ceiling; that record and the rest are deferred whole (never partially populated) and listed in `deferred.records`. Response envelope fields — `notFound`, `deferred` itself — are not counted. Omit to return every resolved record.

source.description: Europe PMC source the record was resolved from

title.description: Record title as display-ready plain text — JATS/HTML markup stripped and HTML entities decoded.

authors.description: Formatted author string as display-ready plain text — JATS/HTML markup stripped and HTML entities decoded.

journal.description: Journal name as Europe PMC reports it — its MEDLINE abbreviation where it records one (e.g. `Otolaryngol Pol`), else the full journal title — the same name `pubmed_europepmc_search` returns for the record. Display-ready plain text — JATS/HTML markup stripped and HTML entities decoded. Absent when Europe PMC carries no journal, as for preprints.

pmcId.description: PMC ID when present in PMC

doi.description: DOI when present, cased as Europe PMC reports it. DOIs are case-insensitive by spec and no case normalization is applied here, so the same DOI can arrive in a different case from `pubmed_fetch_articles` (Europe PMC `10.1056/nejmoa2212948`, NCBI `10.1056/NEJMoa2212948`) — a byte-for-byte comparison across the two reports a false mismatch.

isOpenAccess.description: Whether Europe PMC reports the record as open access

hasFullTextXml.description: Whether Europe PMC publishes a fullTextXML for this record: true when Europe PMC marks it open access and lists a full-text id for it, open-access preprints (`PPR`) included; false otherwise. Absent when Europe PMC reports no open-access status.

license.description: License Europe PMC records for this record, verbatim (e.g. `cc by`, `cc by-nc-nd`, `cc0`). Relayed as Europe PMC states it, never interpreted. Absent when Europe PMC supplies none.

abstract.description: Complete abstract as display-ready plain text — JATS/HTML markup stripped and HTML entities decoded, never truncated. Omitted when Europe PMC carries no abstract for the record.

citedByCount.description: Citation count reported by Europe PMC

items.description: Complete Europe PMC record

records.description: Resolved records, in the order Europe PMC returned them. Under a `maxResponseCharacters` budget, only the leading records that fit; `deferred.records` lists the rest.

notFound.description: Requested `source` + `epmcId` pairs Europe PMC returned no record for. Reported in full regardless of where a `maxResponseCharacters` cut lands — these are misses, not deferrals.

source.description: Europe PMC source corpus — `MED` (PubMed), `PMC` (PubMed Central), `PPR` (preprint), `PAT` (patent), `AGR` (Agricola). Copy it from the search hit's `source`. `PMC` paired with a PMCID resolves whether or not the article is also indexed in PubMed, and a PubMed-indexed one comes back as its canonical `MED` record carrying that PMCID in `pmcId`.

epmcId.description: Europe PMC's own record id within that source. Copy it from the search hit's `epmcId` — for `MED` records this is the PMID; for the other sources it is an EPMC-native accession.

items.description: One record address: the Europe PMC source corpus plus its id within that corpus

maxResponseCharacters.description: The `maxResponseCharacters` ceiling this response was budgeted against

returnedCharacters.description: Serialized characters the returned records account for

deferredCount.description: Records that resolved but were withheld to stay under the ceiling

source.description: Europe PMC source the record was resolved from

items.description: One deferred record, addressed by its own `source` + `epmcId`

nextDeferredCharacters.description: Serialized size of the next deferred record — the first entry in `records`, where the response stopped — and the continuation ceiling: re-calling with the deferred pairs needs `maxResponseCharacters` ≥ this to return anything, and a smaller record further down `records` cannot be reached until this one fits. Repeating this same call needs `maxResponseCharacters` ≥ `returnedCharacters` + this to return this record as well.

deferred.description: Continuation state for records the whole-response budget withheld. Present only when `maxResponseCharacters` deferred at least one record.

notice.description: Guidance when one or more requested records could not be resolved, or when `maxResponseCharacters` deferred records — naming how to retrieve them. Absent when every requested record came back.

truncated.description: True when `maxResponseCharacters` withheld at least one resolved record. Absent when the response carries every record that resolved. The continuation state is in `deferred`.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

Declared by this tool: `europepmc_unreachable`: Europe PMC failed on every retry attempt — unreachable, an HTTP 404 or 5xx other than a 504 timeout from its search endpoint, or an empty response with no results. `europepmc_invalid_response`: Europe PMC returned a body that could not be parsed (invalid JSON or XML). `europepmc_invalid_input`: Europe PMC rejected the request input — an error message in place of results; a sort it cannot use (one whose keys are not each a field plus asc/desc, rejected before any request; an empty response to a sort with an undocumented field; or a second HTTP 503 to a sorted search when the same query without the sort is served); or a pagination cursor it cannot read (an empty response on the last attempt the retry budget allows, or a second HTTP 503 when the first page of the same query is served). `europepmc_disabled`: Europe PMC service is disabled via EUROPEPMC_ENABLED=false. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

definition.name: pubchem__pubchem_search_compounds_0fb2dcb5
definition.title: Search Compounds
definition.description: Search PubChem for chemical compounds by identifier (name, SMILES, InChI, or InChIKey, up to 25 per call), molecular formula in Hill notation, substructure or superstructure containment, 2D Tanimoto similarity, or the compounds a bioassay (AID) found active or tested. Returns a page of CIDs — reach matches past maxResults with offset. Optionally hydrate results with properties to avoid a follow-up pubchem_get_compound_details call.

searchType.description: Search strategy; each mode needs its own fields. "identifier": name/SMILES/InChI/InChIKey lookup — requires identifierType and identifiers. "formula": molecular formula — requires formula. "substructure": find compounds containing the query as a substructure. "superstructure": find compounds that are themselves substructures of the query. "similarity": 2D Tanimoto similarity to the query. substructure, superstructure, and similarity require query and queryType. "assay": compounds tested in a PubChem bioassay — requires aid; activeOnly (default true) keeps only the compounds the assay marked active.

identifierType.description: Required for identifier search. Type of chemical identifier: "name", "smiles", "inchi" (a full InChI string, case-sensitive), or "inchikey".

identifiers.description: Required for identifier search. Array of identifiers to resolve. The per-call cap is 25: the first 25 are looked up, and any past that (up to 1000 in all) are returned in unprocessed, in input order, and reported in cappedInputs. Examples: ["aspirin", "ibuprofen"] for name, ["CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O"] for SMILES, ["InChI=1S/C9H8O4/c1-6(10)13-8-5-3-2-4-7(8)9(11)12/h2-5H,1H3,(H,11,12)"] for inchi (sent exactly as written, case kept), ["BSYNRYMUTXBXSQ-UHFFFAOYSA-N"] for inchikey (27-char block format; uppercased before lookup, any case accepted).

formula.description: Required for formula search. Molecular formula in Hill notation (e.g. "C6H12O6", "CaH2O2").

allowOtherElements.description: Formula search only. When true, includes compounds with additional elements beyond the formula.

query.description: Required for substructure/superstructure/similarity searches. A SMILES string (e.g. "CC(=O)O") or PubChem CID as a string from 1 to 2147483647 (e.g. "2244").

queryType.description: Required for structure/similarity searches. Format of the query: "smiles" or "cid".

threshold.description: Similarity search only. Minimum Tanimoto similarity (70-100). 90+ for close analogs, 70-80 for scaffold hops. Default: 90.

aid.description: Required for assay search. PubChem Assay ID (AID) whose compounds to list, from 1 to 2147483647, e.g. 1000. Find AIDs for a biological target with pubchem_search_assays.

activeOnly.description: Assay search only. When true (default), lists only the compounds the assay marked active; false lists every compound it tested.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first CID to return. Pass the nextOffset from a previous call to read the following page. Identifier lookups resolve every match up front, so paging them is free, and assay searches fetch only the requested page, so both page to the end of their matches. Formula, substructure, superstructure, and similarity searches have to ask PubChem for offset + maxResults records to reach a page, so deep pages cost progressively more upstream: those four accept an offset up to 10000. Default: 0.

maxResults.description: Maximum CIDs to return per page. The per-call cap is 200: a larger value (up to 1000) returns a page of 200 and is reported in cappedInputs. Use offset to reach matches past this page. Default: 20.

properties.description: Optional: fetch these properties for each result, avoiding a follow-up details call. E.g. ["MolecularFormula", "MolecularWeight", "CanonicalSMILES"].
Compound properties keyed by name (echoes input.properties; only present when requested).

items.description: Matching compound entry.

unresolvedIdentifiers.description: Identifier-mode only: input identifiers that resolved to no CID — PubChem had no match, or could not interpret the input as identifierType (the notice says which). Omitted when every identifier resolved and for non-identifier searches.

unprocessed.description: Identifier-mode only: identifiers past the per-call cap of 25, in input order, not looked up. Pass them in a follow-up call. Omitted when every identifier was looked up.

searchType.description: Search strategy used: identifier, formula, substructure, superstructure, similarity, or assay.

activeOnly.description: Assay search only: true when the list holds only the compounds the assay marked active, false when it holds every compound tested.

totalFound.description: Exact number of matching CIDs across all pages. Omitted when a formula, substructure, superstructure, or similarity search saturated the records it requested — PubChem returns no match count for those, so totalFoundAtLeast reports a floor instead.

totalFoundAtLeast.description: Lower bound on matching CIDs, reported in place of totalFound when the exact count is unavailable. At least this many match, and the true total may be higher; page further with offset to observe more.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first CID returned.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call to continue past this page. Omitted when no further matches remain, and when a formula, substructure, superstructure, or similarity page would continue past the 10000 offset ceiling (truncated stays true, and the notice says how to narrow the search and names the page at offset 10000 when it still reaches further matches).

truncated.description: True when matching CIDs remain past this page.

cap.description: The page size applied: maxResults, or the per-call cap when maxResults exceeds it.

cappedInputs.description: Inputs that asked for more than their per-call cap, with the value requested and the value served. An ID batch lists the IDs past the cap in unprocessed. Omitted when every input was within its cap.

requested.description: Value requested: the page size, or the number of IDs in the batch.

unprocessed.description: ID batches only: IDs past the cap, listed in unprocessed in input order.

items.description: One input served at its per-call cap.

notice.description: Recovery guidance when no compounds matched (for an assay search, when the assay recorded none of the requested kind), when the offset runs past the matches observed, when identifiers had no match or could not be interpreted, when identifiers collided on one CID, when further pages remain, or when a bounded search reached the offset ceiling. Absent when this page is complete and every identifier resolved to its own CID.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_identifier_args`: searchType is "identifier" but identifierType or identifiers were omitted. `missing_formula`: searchType is "formula" but the formula field was omitted or blank. `missing_structure_args`: substructure/superstructure/similarity search with query or queryType omitted, or a blank query. `invalid_cid_query`: structure/similarity search with queryType "cid" but query is not an integer CID from 1 to 2147483647. `offset_ceiling_exceeded`: formula, substructure, superstructure, or similarity search with offset above 10000. `missing_aid`: searchType is "assay" but aid was omitted. `aid_not_found`: assay search where PubChem has no live assay with the given AID. `identifier_rejected`: identifier search where PubChem rejected every identifier in the batch as unreadable (HTTP 400) — for SMILES or InChI, a string it could not standardize into a structure. A batch with any other outcome lists rejected inputs in unresolvedIdentifiers instead. `search_query_rejected`: PubChem failed a formula, substructure, superstructure, or similarity search with HTTP 500 "Search status indicates failure" — its answer for a malformed SMILES or formula, a SMILES with a "*" wildcard atom, or a CID with no record — or refused any of these searches with HTTP 400, as it does a formula carrying a line break, another C0 control character other than tab and NUL, or DEL. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

definition.name: pubchem__pubchem_get_compound_details_e3a3fb7f
definition.title: Get Compound Details
definition.description: Get detailed compound information by CID. Returns physicochemical properties (molecular weight, SMILES, InChIKey, XLogP, TPSA, etc.), optionally with a textual description (pharmacology, mechanism, therapeutic use), known synonyms, drug-likeness assessment (Lipinski/Veber rules), and/or pharmacological classification (FDA classes, MeSH classes, ATC codes). Fetches up to 100 CIDs per call; CIDs past that are returned in unprocessed for a follow-up call.

cids.description: PubChem Compound IDs to fetch. The per-call cap is 100: the first 100 are fetched, and any past that (up to 1000 in all) are returned in unprocessed, in input order, and reported in cappedInputs. Resolve from names/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

properties.description: Properties to retrieve. Defaults to a core set: MolecularFormula, MolecularWeight, IUPACName, CanonicalSMILES, IsomericSMILES, InChIKey, XLogP, TPSA, HBondDonorCount, HBondAcceptorCount, RotatableBondCount, HeavyAtomCount, Charge, Complexity.

includeDescription.description: Include textual descriptions (pharmacology, mechanism, therapeutic use) attributed by source. Well-studied compounds have many overlapping summaries — paged via descriptionOffset/maxDescriptions. Fetched only for the first 10 CIDs in the batch; remaining CIDs return without descriptions and are listed in the response's skippedCids.

descriptionOffset.description: Zero-based index of the first description to return within each compound's description list. The same offset is applied to every compound in the batch. Pass the nextDescriptionOffset from a previous call to read the following page. Default: 0.

maxDescriptions.description: Max number of distinct description entries per compound per page. The per-call cap is 20: a larger value (up to 1000) returns 20 per compound and is reported in cappedInputs. PubChem returns near-duplicate summaries from many depositors; duplicates are collapsed before this cap applies. Default: 3.

includeSynonyms.description: Fetch known names and synonyms (trade names, systematic names, registry numbers), paged via synonymOffset/maxSynonyms. Fetched for every found CID in the batch. Slower for large CID lists.

synonymOffset.description: Zero-based index of the first synonym to return within each compound's synonym list. The same offset is applied to every compound in the batch. Pass the nextSynonymOffset from a previous call to read the following page. Default: 0.

definition.name: pubchem__pubchem_get_compound_3d_structure_1872f4cf
definition.title: Get Compound 3D Structure
definition.description: Get a compound's default 3D conformer — atomic coordinates and bonds — for one CID. format="json" (default) returns atoms and bonds parsed into structured fields; format="sdf" returns the raw V2000 SDF text for passthrough to docking, rendering, or conformer tools. Optionally lists alternate conformer IDs. Not every compound has computed 3D coordinates (large molecules, mixtures, and some salts do not).

cid.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

includeAlternateConformerIds.description: List the IDs of additional computed conformers beyond the default. Slower than the default response. Default: false.

maxAtoms.description: Cap the atoms returned in the format="json" preview. atomCount always reports the full total; omitted rows are disclosed via the truncated/shownAtoms enrichment. Defaults to the first 200 atoms.

maxBonds.description: Cap the bonds returned in the format="json" preview. bondCount always reports the full total; omitted rows are disclosed via the truncated/shownBonds enrichment. Defaults to the first 200 bonds.

includeRawSdf.description: For format="sdf", return the complete raw V2000 SDF even when it exceeds the safe line cap. Default false: an SDF longer than 500 lines is line-capped with disclosure. No effect when format="json".

alternateConformerIds.description: Conformer IDs beyond the default. Present when includeAlternateConformerIds is set and alternates exist.

shownBonds.description: Bonds returned after the cap, when fewer than bondCount. Raise maxBonds for more.

bondCap.description: The bond cap applied (explicit maxBonds or the safe default), when the bond list was capped.

definition.name: pubchem__pubchem_get_compound_xrefs_96c0c454
definition.title: Get Compound Cross-References
definition.description: Get external database cross-references for a compound: PubMed citations, patent IDs, gene associations, CAS and EC numbers with the number of source records that deposited each, other registry numbers, and taxonomy IDs. Results are paged per type — capped at maxPerType with the total count reported; reach the IDs past a page with offset. PubMed IDs come highest (most recently assigned) first and the other numeric types in ascending order; CAS and EC come most-attested first; the other string IDs keep PubChem's order. A type that fails to load is named in failedTypes while the others still return; the call fails only when a type fails and no type other than ProteinGI (which PubChem no longer serves) loads.

cid.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

xrefTypes.description: Cross-reference types to retrieve. String IDs: CAS (the CAS Registry Numbers deposited for this compound, most-attested first, each with the number of source records that deposited it — the first is the value most source records agree on), EC (European Community numbers, ordered and counted the same way), RN (every registry number PubChem associates with the record, unranked: the CAS number alongside deprecated and related CAS RNs, CAS RNs of other substances mapped to the structure, and EC numbers), RegistryID (DSSTox/EPA registry numbers), PatentID. Numeric IDs: PubMedID, GeneID (NCBI Gene — use it for gene/protein associations), ProteinGI (legacy NCBI Protein GI; PubChem currently returns no data for it, so use GeneID instead), TaxonomyID.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first ID to return within each xref type. The same offset is applied to every requested type. Pass the nextOffset from a previous call to read the following page. Default: 0.

maxPerType.description: Max IDs to return per xref type per page. The per-call cap is 500: a larger value (up to 1000) returns 500 per type and is reported in cappedInputs. A compound may have thousands of PubMed references; use offset to reach the ones past this page. Total count always reported. Default: 50.

type.description: Cross-reference type: CAS, EC, RN, RegistryID, PubMedID, PatentID, GeneID, ProteinGI, or TaxonomyID. PubChem currently returns no data for ProteinGI; GeneID carries gene/protein associations.

anyOf.description: String-form cross-reference ID (e.g. CAS number, patent).
Numeric cross-reference ID (e.g. PubMed ID, Gene ID).

items.description: Cross-reference identifier — string or number depending on type.

ids.description: Cross-reference IDs on this page (window of offset + maxPerType). PubMedID is sorted numerically descending, so page one holds the highest, most recently assigned PMIDs; GeneID, ProteinGI and TaxonomyID numerically ascending; CAS and EC by the number of source records that deposited each, most first (ties in PubChem's order), so ids[0] is the value most source records agree on; RegistryID, RN and PatentID keep PubChem's order.

sourceCounts.description: CAS and EC only: how many source records deposited each ID on this page, aligned with ids — sourceCounts[i] is the count for ids[i]. One source can deposit several records, so this counts records, not distinct source names. More than one ID means the source records disagree; the counts show by how much.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call to continue past this page. Omitted when no requested type has further IDs.

failedTypes.description: Requested xref types that could not be retrieved (comma-separated). The returned groups cover the types that loaded. A retry can recover a type that failed transiently (a timeout, network error, rate limit, or 5xx), and the notice names those; a type PubChem rejected fails the same way again.

notice.description: Guidance when a type failed to load, when every requested xref type returned zero IDs, when the offset runs past every type, when further pages remain, or when ProteinGI came back empty (PubChem serves no ProteinGI data). Absent when this page is complete and non-empty.

cappedInputs.description: Inputs that asked for more than their per-call cap, with the value requested and the value served. An ID batch lists the IDs past the cap in unprocessed. Omitted when every input was within its cap.

definition.name: pubchem__pubchem_get_compound_safety_c17f8990
definition.title: Get Compound Safety
definition.description: Get GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard classification and safety data for one or more compounds by CID. Returns signal word, pictograms, hazard statements (H-codes), and precautionary statements (P-codes) per compound, merged across sources, plus each source's own classification — its signal word, pictograms, H-codes with ECHA notifier agreement percentages, and notification counts — since sources often disagree. Reports ECHA "Not Classified" verdicts as their own status.

cids.description: PubChem Compound IDs to fetch safety data for. The per-call cap is 25: the first 25 are looked up, and any past that (up to 1000 in all) are returned in unprocessed, in input order, and reported in cappedInputs. Resolve from names/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

hasData.description: Whether a GHS classification is on file for this compound (status "ok" or "not_classified"); "ghs" is present exactly when this is true.

status.description: Outcome for this CID. "ok": GHS hazard classification returned. "not_classified": every deposited classification is an ECHA "Not Classified" verdict — notifiers assessed the compound and found it meets no GHS hazard criteria; the verdicts and their notifier counts are in ghs.classifications. "no_ghs_data": the compound exists in PubChem but has no deposited GHS classification. "cid_not_found": PubChem has no record for this CID at all — the identifier is wrong, so verify it with pubchem_search_compounds rather than concluding the compound is unclassified.

signalWord.description: GHS signal word, "Danger" or "Warning": the most severe any classification assigns. Omitted when none assigns one.

pictograms.description: GHS pictogram labels (e.g. "Flammable", "Acute Toxic"), union across classifications.

code.description: H-code (e.g. "H225").

items.description: GHS hazard statement entry.

hazardStatements.description: GHS hazard statements, union across classifications. A code here may come from a single source — see classifications for which source assigned it and with what notifier agreement.

code.description: P-code (e.g. "P210").

statement.description: Standard precautionary statement text for the code. Empty string when "decoded" is false — PubChem deposits P-codes without text, so a blank statement means the code was not decoded, never that the depositor supplied an empty statement.

decoded.description: Whether "statement" carries the standard text. False for codes needing label-specific fill text the depositor must supply (disposal method, firefighting agent, first-aid reference) and for codes outside the decoder table; the code itself is still authoritative.

items.description: GHS precautionary statement entry.

precautionaryStatements.description: GHS precautionary statements, union across classifications.

source.description: Depositing source (e.g. "European Chemicals Agency (ECHA)", "NITE-CMC"). Omitted when PubChem names no reference for the classification.

sourceRecord.description: The source's own record title (e.g. "Ethanol - FY2013 (Revised classification)", "Ethanol (EC: 200-578-6)"). Tells revisions of one source, and the ECHA C&L aggregate from single-company ECHA notifications, apart.

signalWord.description: This classification's signal word. Omitted when the source assigns none.

code.description: H-code (e.g. "H319"). Statement text is in the top-level hazardStatements.

agreement.description: Share of notifying companies that assigned this code, exactly as PubChem prints it (e.g. "37.7%", "> 99.9%"). Present only where PubChem prints one beside the code, which is ECHA C&L classifications; read it against "notifications" — a single-company notification reports 100%.

notClassified.description: True when this classification is ECHA's "Not Classified" verdict: notifiers assessed the compound and found it meets no GHS hazard criteria. Omitted otherwise.

notifications.description: Notifier counts behind an ECHA classification: the first line of ECHA's C&L notifications summary (e.g. "Aggregated GHS information provided per 13886 reports by companies from 79 notifications…"), or for a "Not Classified" verdict the verdict line (e.g. "Reported as not meeting GHS hazard criteria by 188 of 203 companies…"). Omitted for sources that deposit no counts.

definition.name: pubchem__pubchem_get_bioactivity_a04c15eb
definition.title: Get Bioactivity
definition.description: Get a compound's bioactivity profile: which assays tested it, activity outcomes (Active/Inactive/Inconclusive), target identifiers (NCBI Gene ID, UniProt/GenBank accession), quantitative values (IC50, EC50, Ki, etc.), each assay's type (confirmatory, screening, summary, other), and the PubMed IDs it cites. Filter by outcome, a specific molecular target (NCBI Gene ID or protein accession), and/or assay type to focus the profile — e.g. "is this compound active against target T in confirmatory assays?".

cid.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

outcomeFilter.description: Filter by activity outcome against each assay's reported target: the target a target filter matched, else the first target the assay lists. For a multi-target assay, outcomes against its other targets (in otherTargets) do not count. "active" keeps assays where that outcome is Active — most useful for understanding biological profile. Default: "all".

targetGeneId.description: Filter to assays against this NCBI Gene ID (1 to 2147483647), including assays recorded only under a protein accession this compound's assay table pairs with the Gene ID (e.g. 5742 also reaches rows carrying only P23219 when another row pairs the two). Obtain Gene IDs from the GeneID:N in a pubchem_get_compound_interactions target entry's partner (kinds: ["target"]) or the targetGeneId field of a result here without a target filter (rows from untargeted screens carry none). Combine with outcomeFilter="active" to answer "is this compound active against target T?".

targetAccession.description: Filter to assays against this target protein accession (UniProt/RefSeq/GenBank/PDB chain), e.g. "P35354", including assays recorded only under a Gene ID or another accession this compound's assay table pairs with it. Uppercased before matching; a PDB chain ID (the "A" in "1ZHH_A") is kept as given. With targetGeneId, both must name the same target — when the table ties them to different targets, nothing matches. Obtain accessions from an assay's targets in pubchem_get_summary (entityType "assay"), the accession:X in a pubchem_get_compound_interactions target entry's partner, or the targetAccession field of a result here without a target filter.

assayType.description: Keep only assays of these types: "confirmatory" (dose-response and other follow-up assays), "screening" (primary high-throughput screens), "summary" (records summarizing a project's assays), "other". Matched against PubChem's Assay Type regardless of case; an assay with no recorded type matches none. Combines with outcomeFilter and the target filters — an assay must pass all of them. Omit to keep every type.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first assay to return, applied after the outcome and target filters. Pass the nextOffset from a previous call to read the following page. Default: 0.

maxResults.description: Max assay results to return per page. The per-call cap is 100: a larger value (up to 1000) returns a page of 100 and is reported in cappedInputs. Well-studied compounds have thousands of records; use offset to reach the ones past this page. Default: 20.

totalAssays.description: Total unique assays for this compound.

activeCount.description: Assays whose outcome against their first listed target is "Active", across all assays and before any filter. A multi-target assay counts by its first target only.

inactiveCount.description: Assays whose outcome against their first listed target is "Inactive", across all assays and before any filter. A multi-target assay counts by its first target only.

assayType.description: PubChem's assay type as written: Confirmatory, Screening, Summary, or Other. Omitted when PubChem records none.

pmids.description: PubMed IDs of the publications the assay cites, highest (most recently assigned) first. Omitted when it cites none.

outcome.description: Activity outcome against the reported target — the one a target filter matched, else the assay's first: Active, Inactive, Inconclusive, Unspecified.

name.description: Measurement name (e.g. IC50, EC50, Ki). Omitted when not reported.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. uM, nM). Omitted when not reported.

items.description: Quantitative activity measurement entry.

activityValues.description: Quantitative activity measurements against the reported target.

otherTargets.description: The assay's other targets, each with its own outcome and measurements. Present only for an assay whose rows name more than one target.

accession.description: Protein accession. Omitted when the row names none.

geneId.description: NCBI Gene ID. Omitted when the row names none.

name.description: Measurement name (e.g. IC50, EC50, Ki). Omitted when not reported.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. uM, nM). Omitted when not reported.

outcomeFilter.description: Outcome filter applied: active, inactive, or all.

targetFilter.description: Target identifiers matched, when a target filter is set: those passed plus every Gene ID and accession the compound's assay table pairs with them. When the two inputs name different targets, only the two inputs.

assayTypeFilter.description: Assay types kept, comma-separated (e.g. "confirmatory, summary"), when assayType is set.

filteredCount.description: Exact number of assays matching the outcome, target, and assay-type filters, across all pages.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call to continue past this page. Omitted when no further assays match.

cap.description: The page size applied: maxResults, or the per-call cap when maxResults exceeds it.

cappedInputs.description: Inputs that asked for more than their per-call cap, with the value requested and the value served. An ID batch lists the IDs past the cap in unprocessed. Omitted when every input was within its cap.

requested.description: Value requested: the page size, or the number of IDs in the batch.

unprocessed.description: ID batches only: IDs past the cap, listed in unprocessed in input order.
