reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: Crossref answered HTTP 429 and the limit did not clear inside the retry budget. `upstream_unavailable`: Crossref was unreachable, returned a 5xx status, or served an HTML error page instead of JSON. `malformed_response`: Crossref returned HTTP 200 with a body that is not valid JSON. `request_timeout`: Crossref did not respond within CROSSREF_TIMEOUT_MS, or answered HTTP 408/504. `invalid_cursor`: Crossref did not recognize the cursor token (HTTP 404 cursor-invalid). `invalid_parameter`: Crossref rejected a parameter value (a filter value of the wrong type or form), or answered HTTP 400 with a body that did not parse. `funder_not_found`: Funder DOI lookup returned 404 — funder is not in the Crossref Funder Registry. `ambiguous_funder`: include_works is true but the name query matched more than one funder, making the target ambiguous. `offset_too_large`: offset is at or past the 100000-record ceiling Crossref puts on offset + rows on funder name search, so no funder page starts there. `works_offset_too_large`: works_offset is at or past the 10000-record ceiling Crossref puts on works_offset + rows on a funded-works list, so no works page starts there. `works_cursor_offset_conflict`: include_works is true and works_cursor was supplied alongside a works_offset above zero. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

definition.name: crossref__crossref_get_member_e1b9cf78
definition.title: Get Member by ID
definition.description: Resolves a Crossref member ID to its publisher/organization record: primary name, alternate imprint names, owned DOI prefixes, registered DOI counts, a per-work-type breakdown, and per-category metadata deposit coverage. Members are the organizations that register DOIs with Crossref, so this answers "what does this publisher publish, and how completely do they deposit metadata?" The member that holds a DOI now is the memberId crossref_get_work or crossref_search_works returns for it — pass that ID here. crossref_get_prefix returns the member a DOI prefix record names, the prefix's registrant, which for a transferred title is a former publisher rather than the DOI's current one.

member_id.description: Crossref member ID — a positive integer, e.g. 297 (Springer) or 340 (PLOS). A DOI's current member is the memberId crossref_get_work returns for it.

id.description: Crossref member ID

names.description: Alternate and imprint names registered under this member

prefixes.description: DOI prefixes owned by this member, e.g. "10.1038"

totalDois.description: Total DOIs registered by this member (current + backfile)

currentDois.description: DOIs registered in the current (recent) window

backfileDois.description: DOIs registered in the backfile (older) window

worksByType.description: DOI counts broken down by work type (all DOIs), sorted by count descending

type.description: Crossref work type, e.g. "journal-article", "book-chapter", "posted-content"

count.description: Number of DOIs of this type registered by the member

items.description: DOI count for one work type

coverage.description: Per-category metadata deposit coverage — each a 0–1 fraction split into current (recent) and backfile (older) DOIs. Signals how completely this publisher deposits references, abstracts, ORCIDs, funders, licenses, and similar metadata.

items.description: Metadata deposit coverage for one category

deposits.description: Whether the member deposits any metadata with Crossref

depositsArticles.description: Whether the member deposits journal-article metadata

definition.name: crossref__crossref_get_prefix_9d80f14e
definition.title: Get Prefix Owner
definition.description: Resolves a DOI prefix — the registrant portion of a DOI, e.g. "10.1038" — to the Crossref member its prefix record names: the publisher name and numeric member ID. That member is the prefix's registrant, so for a title transferred to another publisher it is not the member holding the DOI now — crossref_get_work's memberId names that one. The Crossref prefix record carries only these three facts (no counts, coverage, or flags); the returned memberId chains directly into crossref_get_member for the full publisher record.

prefix.description: DOI prefix in the format "10.NNNN" — the registrant portion of a DOI with no "/suffix", e.g. "10.1038" or "10.1371".
The DOI prefix that was resolved, e.g. "10.1038"

ownerName.description: Name of the member (publisher) the prefix record names — its registrant

memberId.description: Numeric Crossref member ID the prefix record names — pass to crossref_get_member for the full publisher record. For a transferred title it is a former publisher; a DOI's current member is the memberId crossref_get_work returns.

definition.name: chembl__chembl_search_molecules_c386bd4b
definition.title: chembl-search-molecules
definition.description: Discovery entry point for compounds. Find by name / ChEMBL ID / InChIKey with the default search_type=name (supply query), or run a structure search with search_type exact | similarity | substructure (supply structure as a SMILES). At least one of query or structure is required, and structure is required for the three structure modes. Returns ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, formula, MW, AlogP, Lipinski violations, QED, max clinical phase, and the family parent_chembl_id on every row; only search_type=similarity adds a Tanimoto similarity percent. Chain molecule_chembl_id into chembl_get_bioactivities or chembl_get_drug_info. A salt often ranks ahead of its parent and carries a small share of the family's measurements, so check parent_chembl_id before chaining. A capped result carries nextCursor — pass it back as cursor with the same filters to read the next page.

query.description: Search text for search_type=name — a drug name, ChEMBL ID, or InChIKey, e.g. "imatinib" or "CHEMBL25".

structure.description: SMILES string for structure search, e.g. "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O". Required when search_type is exact/similarity/substructure.

search_type.description: name = text lookup (query); exact = exact structure match; similarity = Tanimoto ≥ threshold; substructure = contains the structure. All structure modes need `structure`.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum Tanimoto similarity percent for search_type=similarity (40–100; ChEMBL rejects below 40). Ignored for other modes.

max_phase_min.description: For search_type=name, restrict to compounds at or above this max clinical phase (e.g. 4 for marketed drugs only).

limit.description: Maximum molecules to return, up to 100 — a larger value is served at 100, with a notice saying so. Defaults to the server default (25) when omitted.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous call's nextCursor — resumes where that page ended. Omit for the first page. Re-send the same query/structure/filters that minted it (only limit may change; it sets this page's size); redeeming it against different filters walks a different result set.

molecule_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL molecule ID, e.g. "CHEMBL25". Pass to chembl_get_bioactivities or chembl_get_drug_info.

pref_name.description: Preferred name, e.g. "ASPIRIN". Null for many research compounds.

canonical_smiles.description: Canonical SMILES structure. Null when no structure is recorded.

standard_inchi_key.description: Standard InChIKey — chain to the pubchem server for richer chemistry. Null when absent.

full_molformula.description: Molecular formula, e.g. "C9H8O4". Null when absent.

mw_freebase.description: Molecular weight of the free base in g/mol, e.g. 180.16. Null when absent.

alogp.description: Calculated AlogP lipophilicity, e.g. 1.31. Null when absent.

num_ro5_violations.description: Lipinski rule-of-five violation count (0–4). Null when not computed.

qed_weighted.description: QED weighted drug-likeness score, 0–1. Null when not computed.

max_phase.description: Max clinical phase: 4 = approved, 3–1 = clinical trial phase, 0.5 = early phase 1, −1 = clinical with the phase unknown. Null when ChEMBL records no clinical development (a preclinical or research compound). The cheap druggability signal.

molecule_type.description: Molecule type, e.g. "Small molecule". Null when absent.

parent_chembl_id.description: The parent of the compound's family, e.g. "CHEMBL553" for erlotinib hydrochloride — the compound's own ID when it is the parent or ChEMBL records no hierarchy for it. A salt's measurements are a small share of its family's: pass the parent to chembl_get_drug_info, or set include_alternate_forms on chembl_get_bioactivities, to reach the whole family.

similarity.description: Tanimoto similarity percent (0–100) to the query structure. Present only on search_type=similarity results; on every other search_type the key is absent, not null.

items.description: A compound matched by the search.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next page — pass it back as cursor with the same filters. Absent when this page is the last one.

totalCount.description: Total compounds matching before the limit was applied — a lower bound when totalCountCapped is true.

totalCountCapped.description: True when totalCount is ChEMBL's ceiling for the search — 10000 for a name search, 30000 for a substructure search: at least that many compounds match, and no page past the ceiling can be reached. Narrow the query to bring the matches under it.

truncated.description: True when the result was capped at the limit.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched — echoes the query and suggests how to broaden — the disclosure that a limit above the maximum was served at the maximum, and, when totalCountCapped is true, that the total is ChEMBL's search ceiling and how to narrow below it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: ChEMBL has no record for the requested identifier or structure. `rate_limited`: ChEMBL rate-limits the upstream request. `invalid_structure`: ChEMBL could not parse the SMILES of a similarity or substructure search. `missing_input`: Neither query nor structure was supplied, or a structure search_type was chosen without a structure. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

definition.name: chembl__chembl_get_bioactivities_10f533f8
definition.title: chembl-get-bioactivities
definition.description: The flagship compound↔target bioactivity bridge: measurements for a molecule (target deconvolution / selectivity), a target (lead finding), or both together (how potently one compound hits one target). Supply at least one of molecule_chembl_id (from chembl_search_molecules) or target_chembl_id (from chembl_search_targets) — supplying both narrows to that compound–target pair, supplying neither is an error. A drug's measurements are often split across its salts and other alternate forms, so molecule_chembl_id reads that one form unless include_alternate_forms widens it to the whole family under its parent (a salt's ID included), every view, page, and spill reading the same family. Filter by standard_type (IC50/Ki/EC50/…), minimum potency pchembl_value_min, assay_type, organism, and variant (wild type, or one recorded mutant such as "T315I"). Each row carries its activity_comment and data_validity_comment, its assay variant, and its source document for citation. Not every measurement has a derivable pchembl_value, so potency_view picks which side of that split you get: the default "potency_ranked" returns the measurements that have one, most potent first (ChEMBL sorts the rest first otherwise, which is why they are not merged), and "null_potency" returns exactly the measurements that have none. totalCount is the honest full match count across both views either way. Mixing measurement types (IC50 vs Ki) is a scientific error — set standard_type to compare like with like. A popular target carries tens of thousands of rows: results spill to a DataCanvas table (call chembl_dataframe_describe for its columns, then chembl_dataframe_query for honest aggregates across the staged set), while an inline preview answers the immediate question. Each view stages its own table (bioactivities / bioactivities_null_potency), so running both against one canvas_id lets a UNION ALL rebuild the full set. A canvas is minted only when a view spills; pass its canvas_id back and every later non-cursor call re-stages the table of its view with its own rows, even when they fit inline or none match, so a successful call never leaves rows from an earlier query in it, and a spill that fails or is cancelled leaves the earlier table in place. The spill is bounded by a row cap (CHEMBL_MAX_SPILL_ROWS) and a time budget (CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS); when either stops it short of the view, truncated is true, truncated_by names the bound, and the table is a bounded slice, not the complete view. The inline rows are always capped at limit, so compare that against totalCount before treating them as the whole answer. Spilling needs the canvas, which is on unless the server sets CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none. Whenever a call stages nothing and rows remain past this page — the canvas is off, or the view fit inline with no canvas_id — nextCursor continues the view: pass it back as cursor, with the same filters and potency_view, for the next page. A cursor page is always returned inline and never staged, canvas or not.

molecule_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL molecule ID (from chembl_search_molecules), e.g. "CHEMBL941". Supply this, target_chembl_id, or both — both narrows to that compound–target pair.

include_alternate_forms.description: Widen molecule_chembl_id to its whole family: the parent it belongs to and every salt and other alternate form ChEMBL files under it (a drug's measurements are often split across them). A salt's ID reaches its parent's family; each row keeps the molecule_chembl_id of the form it was measured on. Requires molecule_chembl_id; combines with target_chembl_id and every filter. Defaults to false: that one form's measurements only.

target_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL target ID (from chembl_search_targets), e.g. "CHEMBL203". Supply this, molecule_chembl_id, or both — both narrows to that compound–target pair.

standard_type.description: Restrict to one measurement type, e.g. "IC50", "Ki", "EC50". Matched exactly, case included — ChEMBL records distinct types that differ only by case, such as "Kd" and "KD". Set this to compare potencies validly.

pchembl_value_min.description: Minimum pchembl_value (−log10 molar potency), e.g. 7 keeps sub-100 nM activities. Only valid on the potency_ranked view — the null_potency rows have no pchembl_value to compare against.

potency_view.description: Which side of the pchembl_value presence split to retrieve. "potency_ranked" (default) returns the measurements that have a derivable pchembl_value, most potent first. "null_potency" returns exactly the measurements that have none — the rows the ranked view excludes, otherwise unreachable. The two partition the match set and stage to separate canvas tables.

assay_type.description: Restrict to an assay type code: "B" (binding), "F" (functional), "A" (ADMET), "T" (toxicity), "P" (physicochemical), "U" (unassigned).

organism.description: Restrict to a target organism, e.g. "Homo sapiens" (case-insensitive exact match).

variant.description: Restrict to one assay variant of the target. "wild_type" keeps the measurements that record no variant. Any other value keeps those whose recorded assay_variant_mutation equals it whole, case-insensitively, with spaces beside "," or "/" ignored: a substitution ("T315I"), a deletion ("F508del"), a multi-mutant in the order ChEMBL records it ("L858R,T790M"; "T790M,L858R" matches nothing, and "L858R" alone matches only the single mutant), or "UNDEFINED MUTATION" for an unspecified mutant. Read assay_variant_mutation on unfiltered rows for the recorded strings.

limit.description: Maximum rows in the inline preview or cursor page, up to 1000 — a larger value is served at 1000, with a notice saying so. Defaults to the server default (25). With the canvas enabled, a view that spills still stages in full whatever the limit; when a call stages nothing, nextCursor reaches the rows past limit.

canvas_id.description: Optional canvas ID from a prior call to reuse the same canvas. With it, the call re-stages the selected potency_view's table with this call's rows whether they spill, fit inline, or are empty, so a second query of the SAME view REPLACES (overwrites) its prior rows once it succeeds — it does not append, and a spill that fails or is cancelled leaves them — while the other view's table is left intact, which is what lets both coexist on one canvas. Omit it and a fresh canvas is minted only if the view spills. Left untouched on a cursor page, which never stages.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous call's nextCursor — resumes the view where that page ended. Omit for the first page. Re-send the same molecule_chembl_id/target_chembl_id, include_alternate_forms, filters, and potency_view that minted it (only limit may change; it sets this page's size); redeeming it against different filters walks a different result set. A cursor page is returned inline and never staged, even with the canvas enabled.

molecule_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL molecule ID of the measured compound.

molecule_pref_name.description: Compound preferred name. Null for many research compounds.

target_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL target ID the compound was measured against.

target_pref_name.description: Target preferred name. Null when unnamed.

target_organism.description: Target organism, e.g. "Homo sapiens". Null when unspecified.

assay_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL assay ID — pass to chembl_get_assay for provenance.

assay_type.description: Assay type code: B=binding, F=functional, A=ADMET, T=toxicity, P=physicochemical, U=unclassified. Null when absent.

assay_description.description: Assay description text. Null when absent.

standard_type.description: Standardized activity type, e.g. "IC50", "Ki", "EC50" — the comparability key. Null when absent.

standard_relation.description: Standardized relation, e.g. "=", ">", "<". Null when absent.

standard_value.description: Standardized value in standard_units. Null when the measurement is missing — never 0.

standard_units.description: Standardized units, e.g. "nM". Null when absent.

pchembl_value.description: −log10(molar potency); the rank field. Null when underivable (non-standard type, censored relation).

type.description: Original (pre-standardization) activity type string from upstream.

value.description: Original value string from upstream — not coerced.

activity_comment.description: Depositor or curator comment on the result, free text such as "Not Active", "Active", or "Inconclusive" — often the only result when standard_value is null. Null when absent.

data_validity_comment.description: ChEMBL data-validity annotation, e.g. "Outside typical range", "Potential transcription error", "Non standard unit for type", or "Manually validated" (a value curators confirmed). Null when unannotated.

assay_variant_mutation.description: Variant of the target protein the assay measured, as ChEMBL records it: a substitution ("T315I"), a deletion ("F508del"), several joined by "," or "/" ("L858R,T790M"), or "UNDEFINED MUTATION" for an unspecified mutant. Null when no variant is recorded.

assay_variant_accession.description: UniProt accession of the variant protein, which can differ from the target's own. Null when no variant is recorded, and for UNDEFINED MUTATION.

document_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL document ID of the publication or deposited dataset the measurement comes from — cite it. Null when absent.

document_year.description: Publication year of the source document. Null when it has none, as for deposited datasets.

items.description: One bioactivity measurement linking a compound, target, and assay.

activities.description: Bioactivity rows for the selected potency_view — the inline preview, the cursor page, or the full view when it fit without spilling.

totalCount.description: Total matching measurements upstream — the honest full count spanning BOTH potency views, before any preview cap. The staged/preview rows are the selected view of this.

potency_view.description: Which view these rows came from: "potency_ranked" = measurements with a derivable pchembl_value; "null_potency" = measurements with none. Re-call with the other value to reach the rest of totalCount.

spilled.description: True when the view exceeded the inline preview and spilled to the canvas. False when it fit inline — including an inline fit re-staged on a supplied canvas_id, which table_name and staged_row_count report.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID holding the staged table — pass to chembl_dataframe_describe to list its columns, then to chembl_dataframe_query to run SQL over them. Null when nothing was staged: canvas disabled, a cursor page, or an inline fit with no canvas_id supplied.

table_name.description: Canvas table name holding the staged rowset, and the FROM target for chembl_dataframe_query SQL — "bioactivities" for potency_ranked, "bioactivities_null_potency" for null_potency. Null when nothing was staged.

staged_row_count.description: Rows actually registered on the canvas table — 0 when a re-staged view matched nothing. Null when nothing was staged. Below the view total when truncated is true.

truncated.description: True when a bound stopped the page walk short of the view — the CHEMBL_MAX_SPILL_ROWS row cap or the CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS time budget, as truncated_by says. The staged table is then a bounded slice, NOT the complete view, so aggregates over it are a sample. Narrow the filters to bring the view under the bound.

truncated_by.description: The bound that cut the staged table short when truncated is true: "row_cap" — the CHEMBL_MAX_SPILL_ROWS cap; "time_budget" — the CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS budget ended the page walk, at its expiry or once what was left would not hold another page, so a re-call can stage more. Null when truncated is false.

canvasDisabled.description: True when the server runs with the canvas off (CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none), so large sets could not spill — the inline rows are one page of the view, not the full set, and nextCursor continues it.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next page of this view — pass it back as cursor with the same filters and potency_view. Minted only when nothing was staged and rows remain past this page: with the canvas disabled, on a cursor page, or when the view fit inline with no canvas_id supplied. Absent on the last page and whenever the call staged a table (a spill, or an inline fit re-staged on a supplied canvas_id).

scope.description: Which IDs scoped the query: the molecule, the target, or both when it narrowed to a compound–target pair. Under include_alternate_forms the molecule side names the family parent whose forms were read.

standard_type.description: The standard_type filter applied, or null.

pchembl_value_min.description: The pchembl_value_min filter applied, or null.

assay_type.description: The assay_type filter applied, or null.

organism.description: The organism filter applied, or null.

variant.description: The variant filter applied — "wild_type", or the variant string matched, spaces beside separators removed — or null.

appliedFilters.description: Filters as the server parsed them.

notice.description: Guidance when no measurements matched (naming the spelling ChEMBL records when the standard_type sent differs from it only by case), how to SQL the staged set, or which rows of the view an inline page holds and how to continue it — led by the disclosure that a limit above the maximum was served at the maximum.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. definition.name: chembl__chembl_search_targets_bd0d9149
definition.title: chembl-search-targets
definition.description: Resolve a protein/gene/UniProt accession to the ChEMBL target ID that chembl_get_bioactivities needs for the target→leads workflow. Supply at least one of accession (UniProt, e.g. P00533), gene_symbol (e.g. EGFR), or query (free-text name); filter further by organism and target_type. Returns each target with its type, organism, and component UniProt accessions + gene symbols. A UniProt accession from the uniprot/protein server is the most precise input. A capped result carries nextCursor — pass it back as cursor with the same filters to read the next page.

query.description: Free-text name match against the target preferred name, e.g. "kinase" or "growth factor receptor".

accession.description: UniProt accession of a target component, e.g. "P00533". The most precise resolver — from the uniprot/protein server.

gene_symbol.description: Gene symbol of a target component, e.g. "EGFR" (case-insensitive exact match).

organism.description: Restrict to a source organism, e.g. "Homo sapiens" (case-insensitive exact match).

target_type.description: Restrict to a target class, e.g. "SINGLE PROTEIN" or "PROTEIN COMPLEX".

limit.description: Maximum targets to return, up to 100 — a larger value is served at 100, with a notice saying so. Defaults to the server default (25) when omitted.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous call's nextCursor — resumes where that page ended. Omit for the first page. Re-send the same accession/gene_symbol/query/filters that minted it (only limit may change; it sets this page's size); redeeming it against different filters walks a different result set.

target_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL target ID, e.g. "CHEMBL203". Pass to chembl_get_bioactivities as target_chembl_id.

pref_name.description: Preferred target name, e.g. "Epidermal growth factor receptor". Null when unnamed.

target_type.description: Target class: "SINGLE PROTEIN", "PROTEIN COMPLEX", "PROTEIN FAMILY", "CELL-LINE", "ORGANISM", etc.

organism.description: Source organism, e.g. "Homo sapiens". Null when unspecified.

accession.description: UniProt accession of the protein component, e.g. "P00533". Null when not a protein target.

items.description: A gene symbol for this component, e.g. "EGFR".

gene_symbols.description: Gene symbols for this component, flattened from component synonyms. Empty when none are recorded.

items.description: One protein component of the target.

components.description: Protein components with UniProt accessions and gene symbols.

items.description: A ChEMBL target resolved from the supplied protein identifier.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next page — pass it back as cursor with the same filters. Absent when this page is the last one.

totalCount.description: Total targets matching the filters before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when the result was capped at the limit.

notice.description: Guidance when no target matched — echoes the filters and suggests how to broaden — and the disclosure that a limit above the maximum was served at the maximum.

definition.name: chembl__chembl_get_drug_info_b253d0b0
definition.title: chembl-get-drug-info
definition.description: Pharmacology for a drug (molecule): mechanism(s) of action, the molecular target(s) it acts on, action type (inhibitor / agonist / …), first-approval year, and clinical indications with the max phase reached for each. Supply molecule_chembl_id (from chembl_search_molecules) — a parent or any of its salts and other alternate forms gives the same answer: ChEMBL often records a drug's mechanisms and approved indications on a salt, so both lists cover the whole family under parent_molecule_chembl_id. Each mechanism names the form it is recorded on, and each indication is listed once per MeSH/EFO pair at the highest phase any form reached, with the forms it is recorded on, each at its own phase. Distinct from the openfda server's label/adverse-event view — this is the curated mechanism-and-indication record. A mechanism's target_chembl_id chains into chembl_get_bioactivities for compounds hitting the same target. Each list carries its own retrieval state: an empty mechanisms or indications array means the molecule has none recorded only when the matching mechanisms_status / indications_status is "complete" — "failed" means the list was not retrieved (the request ran out of time or ChEMBL answered with an error, as the matching *_failure says) and the array says nothing about the molecule, and "truncated" means the page cap fetched fewer rows than ChEMBL holds, which the matching *_total_count reports.

molecule_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL molecule ID (from chembl_search_molecules), e.g. "CHEMBL939" for gefitinib, or the molecule's standard InChIKey, e.g. "XGALLCVXEZPNRQ-UHFFFAOYSA-N". A salt or other alternate form answers with its parent's family, the same as the parent.
The ChEMBL molecule ID queried, as the molecule's own record writes it.

parent_molecule_chembl_id.description: The parent of the queried molecule's family — the molecule itself when it is the parent or ChEMBL records no hierarchy for it. Both lists cover this parent and every alternate form ChEMBL files under it (salts, isotope-labelled and deuterated analogs).

pref_name.description: Preferred drug name, e.g. "GEFITINIB". Null when unnamed.

max_phase.description: Max clinical phase across indications: 4 = approved, 3–1 = trial phase, 0.5 = early phase 1, −1 = clinical with the phase unknown. Null when ChEMBL records no clinical development.

first_approval.description: Year of first approval, e.g. 2003. Null when unapproved or unknown.

target_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL target ID the mechanism acts on — chain to chembl_get_bioactivities. Null when unspecified.

mechanism_of_action.description: Mechanism of action, e.g. "Epidermal growth factor receptor erbB1 inhibitor". Null when absent.

action_type.description: Action type, e.g. "INHIBITOR", "AGONIST", "ANTAGONIST". Null when absent.

molecule_chembl_id.description: The form of the drug the mechanism is recorded on — the parent, or one of its salts or other alternate forms. Null when ChEMBL names none.

items.description: One mechanism of action linked to its molecular target.

mechanisms.description: Mechanisms of action. Empty is authoritative only when mechanisms_status is "complete".

mechanisms_total_count.description: Total mechanism rows ChEMBL holds for the molecule and its alternate forms. Exceeds the returned array length exactly when the status is "truncated". Null when the fetch failed — the count is unknown, never 0.

mechanisms_status.description: Retrieval state of the mechanism list. "complete" = every row ChEMBL records for the molecule and its alternate forms is present, so an empty array is a fact about the molecule. "truncated" = the single-request page cap bounded the list, so the array is a prefix of mechanisms_total_count rows. "failed" = the list was not retrieved (the request ran out of time or ChEMBL answered with an error, as mechanisms_failure says), so the empty array is unknown data, NOT evidence that none exist — re-call chembl_get_drug_info to retry.

mechanisms_failure.description: Why the mechanism list failed, when mechanisms_status is "failed": "timeout" = the request ran out of time before ChEMBL returned the list; "upstream_error" = ChEMBL answered with an error (a rate limit, a server error, a rejected request) or could not be reached. Null when the list did not fail.

mesh_id.description: MeSH descriptor ID, e.g. "D002289". Null when absent.

mesh_heading.description: MeSH disease heading, e.g. "Carcinoma, Non-Small-Cell Lung". Null when absent.

efo_id.description: EFO ontology ID, e.g. "EFO:0003060". Null when absent.

efo_term.description: EFO disease term, e.g. "non-small cell lung carcinoma". Null when absent.

max_phase_for_ind.description: Max clinical phase reached for THIS indication (4 = approved, 3–1 = trial phase, 0.5 = early phase 1, −1 = phase unknown), the highest across the forms it is recorded on. Null when unknown.

molecule_chembl_id.description: A form of the drug the indication is recorded on — the parent, or one of its salts or other alternate forms.

max_phase_for_ind.description: Max clinical phase THIS form reached for the indication — a deuterated analog can sit lower than its parent. Null when unknown.

items.description: One form the indication is recorded on, at its own phase.

forms.description: The forms of the drug the indication is recorded on, each with its own highest phase for it. Empty when ChEMBL names none.

items.description: One clinical indication, listed once per MeSH/EFO pair across the drug and its alternate forms, with the highest phase reached for it and the phase each form reached.

indications.description: Clinical indications. Empty is authoritative only when indications_status is "complete". When "truncated", each indication's max_phase_for_ind and forms are lower bounds: rows past the page cap can raise a phase or add a form.

indications_total_count.description: When the status is "complete", the number of distinct indications — the returned array length, rows recorded on several forms counted once. When "truncated", the indication rows ChEMBL holds for the molecule and its alternate forms, an upper bound on the distinct indications. Null when the fetch failed — the count is unknown, never 0.

indications_rows_fetched.description: Indication rows fetched from ChEMBL for the molecule and its alternate forms, before rows recorded on several forms merge. When the status is "truncated", each row not fetched (indications_total_count minus this) can add at most one indication, so that difference bounds the indications missing. Null when the fetch failed.

indications_status.description: Retrieval state of the indication list. "complete" = every row ChEMBL records for the molecule and its alternate forms is present, so an empty array is a fact about the molecule. "truncated" = the single-request page cap bounded the list, so the array holds the indications of the rows fetched (indications_rows_fetched, fewer than indications_total_count). "failed" = the list was not retrieved (the request ran out of time or ChEMBL answered with an error, as indications_failure says), so the empty array is unknown data, NOT evidence that none exist — re-call chembl_get_drug_info to retry.

indications_failure.description: Why the indication list failed, when indications_status is "failed": "timeout" = the request ran out of time before ChEMBL returned the list; "upstream_error" = ChEMBL answered with an error (a rate limit, a server error, a rejected request) or could not be reached. Null when the list did not fail.

notice.description: Disclosure of anything the two lists do not say for themselves: a list whose upstream fetch timed out or failed (so its emptiness means nothing), a list the page cap bounded, or — only when both lists came back complete and empty — that the molecule may be a research compound rather than a drug.

definition.name: chembl__chembl_dataframe_query_6b7621cf
definition.title: chembl-dataframe-query
definition.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT over the bioactivity rows chembl_get_bioactivities staged on a canvas — rank, group, dedupe, and aggregate across the FULL set, not the inline preview. Reference each staged table by the name chembl_get_bioactivities returned — bioactivities for its potency_ranked view, bioactivities_null_potency for null_potency; discover the staged tables and their columns with chembl_dataframe_describe. Compute honest aggregates here (e.g. SELECT molecule_chembl_id, MEDIAN(pchembl_value) AS med FROM bioactivities WHERE standard_type = 'IC50' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC). Two independent bounds apply, each reported on its own field: truncated is true when the SQL result exceeded the canvas row cap, and rendered_rows says how many of the returned rows the markdown table holds once its character budget is reached (below row_count on a wide or long result). Page past either bound with SQL LIMIT/OFFSET — append e.g. LIMIT 500 OFFSET 500 and re-call; offsets reach rows beyond the canvas row cap. Unavailable when the server sets CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by chembl_get_bioactivities — non-null whenever that call staged a table.

sql.description: A read-only SELECT against the staged tables. Reference tables by the names chembl_get_bioactivities returned.

rows.description: Result rows (capped at the canvas row limit). Each row is a column→value map.

row_count.description: Number of rows materialized in this response.

rendered_rows.description: How many of those rows the markdown table in content[] holds. Below row_count when the rendered table reached its character budget — a rendering bound, INDEPENDENT of truncated: a response can be truncated:false and still render fewer rows than row_count. Re-run the same SQL with LIMIT/OFFSET to read the rows past it.

truncated.description: True when the SQL result exceeded the canvas row cap and was truncated — the engine bounding the result set itself, not the rendering. Independent of rendered_rows; page past it with LIMIT/OFFSET.

definition.name: bgpt__search_papers_0f4fc32e
definition.title: Search scientific evidence
definition.description:
Search claim-level evidence extracted from full-text scientific papers.

Args:
    query: Search terms (e.g. "CRISPR gene editing efficiency"). SHORT, concise queries are best. English language only. Use days_back, num_results, min_citations, and study_type instead of adding years or filters to the query.
    num_results: Number of results to return (1-100, default 16). First 50 results are free, then metered per result for paid users.
    days_back: Only return papers published within the last N days.
    min_citations: Only return papers with at least this many references cited.
    study_type: Only return papers of this study type. One of: primary study | systematic review | meta-analysis | narrative review | protocol | dataset | commentary | other.
    output_format: "evidence" for compact claim-level evidence (default), "legacy" for original paper metadata, or "full" for both.

Returns:
    An envelope whose results list contains papers with claims, experiments, exact results, demonstrated scope, limitations, and provenance.

definition.name: bgpt__lookup_paper_f1a37a57
definition.title: Look up paper by DOI
definition.description:
Look up a single paper by its DOI.

Args:
    doi: The DOI of the paper (e.g. "10.1038/s41586-024-07386-0").
    output_format: "evidence" for compact claim-level evidence (default), "legacy" for original paper metadata, or "full" for both.

Returns:
    An envelope with found status and the paper in result, or a not-found message. A found paper counts as one result.
